name: above_chance
meaning: the full model beats the shuffled-label baseline on the main target by a margin

name: beyond_identity
meaning: morphology carries program information beyond the cell-type composition baseline

name: ci_excludes_zero
meaning: the lower 95 % patient-bootstrap bound of the full model's correlation is above zero

name: shuffled_at_chance
meaning: the shuffled-label baseline sits at chance, so no leak feeds the model

name: calibrated
meaning: the 90 % Gaussian interval covers about 90 % of held-out cells (pooled; read the per-patient spread too)

name: backbone_stable
meaning: the main program has at least three genes that survive stability selection over half-patient refits

name: inference_parity
meaning: the morphology-only inference path reproduces the training-path predictions on a training slide

name: stage_association
meaning: the patient-level vector of predicted program burdens is associated with disease stage

name: external_validation
threshold: validators ran >= 1, every ran validator passed, failed = 0
meaning: every validator that could run on the available data met its own stated bar; skipped validators are listed with their reason
